question: What protection against venom is attained by one accomplished in this practice?
premises: The person may be bitten by great serpents.
Poison would normally enter the body.
In this case poison does not enter the body.
inference: Therefore the accomplished practitioner is protected so that poison does not enter even when bitten by great serpents.
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one is bitten by great serpents.
